name: divergent/overflow-x-suppresses-shrink
divergenceReason: Pilates checks overflowX/overflowY per-axis to suppress flex-shrink on the overflow axis. When overflowX='hidden', Pilates suppresses main-axis shrink so children retain their flexBasis (60 each, total 120 overflowing the 80px container). Yoga has no per-axis overflow API; the fixture loader intentionally leaves Yoga's overflow at 'visible', so Yoga applies flex-shrink normally and children shrink to 40 each.
